Re-check these debrid records against their first-party pages: confirm what still holds, set the fields that changed, and record a dead host as dead with the evidence. Use one `confirm` per evidence row and name only the fields that row's quote proves; list every field you did not re-read in `unread`. Set a field only when the new page states a different value.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- debrid/high-way-premium $.tooling: Tariff page shows WebDAV, FTP, JDownloader, pyLoad, Windows tool, Android app; but SFTP appears only in a link slug and the API /hoster endpoint with per-host discount factor is not on the page.
- debrid/high-way-premium $.identity_cost.detail: Forum prerequisite is stated; e-mail registration with manual review and the payment methods (card, PaysafeCard, Amazon coupon) are not in this capture.
- debrid/high-way-free $.limits[0].value: Prepaid per file and no traffic discount for Free users are stated, but the page does not name the Free MB balance as the source of payment.
- debrid/simply-premium $.chaining: Page lists Usenet and torrent downloads; it does not say the account is German nor that it can replace a usenet provider and a debrid subscription.
- debrid/rlsbb $.interface_detail: Feed has 50 items with links; text/xml content type, dc:creator/category fields and the search.rlsbb.ru light mode are not shown by the capture.
- debrid/high-way-unlimited $.price_per_tb_month: Page lists 750 GB/1 month at 11,99 and 3 TB/1 Jahr at 71,99; the per-TB figures (15.99, 24.00) are derived, and unmetered usenet is not on this page (it is on the tariff page).
- debrid/nasa-earthdata $.identity_cost.detail: Mandatory for DAAC downloads shown; the page does not say registration is free nor that catalogue search needs nothing.
- debrid/scnlog $.free_tier.stated: Capture has 40 feed items; it does not show three direct host links, no registration or no captcha on post pages.
- debrid/high-way-unlimited $.egress.terms: Usenet and TV without traffic counting are stated; "same prepaid traffic model as Premium" and that filehoster traffic is still charged are not stated.
- debrid/high-way-premium $.limits[1].value: Terms: after more than 12 months unused, from the 24th month monthly 10% of original traffic with min 5 GB and max 20 GB, a right reserved; not the claim as worded, and expiry with the package term is not shown.
- debrid/scnlog $.interface_detail: Capture is the feed: 40 items. It shows no content-type, no generator version, no wp-json 401, no /api 404.
- debrid/nasa-earthdata $.egress.terms: Page calls it a user registration and profile management system, but does not say it is free or that it is not payment.
- debrid/simply-premium $.per_object_cap.stated: ddownload.com cap is 50 GB, not 250 GB as claimed; 250 GB hosts are 1fichier, filefactory, filestore.to, mega.co.nz, youtube.com.
- debrid/rlsbb $.limits_note: robots.txt supports the bot list, but a Cloudflare block also has User-agent * Allow: / and Bingbot is allowed; the 2 s response time and no 429 are not in robots.txt.
- debrid/high-way-unlimited $.interface_detail: 20 usenet connections shown; the JSON API at /api/, SFTP and NNTP credentials are not on the page.
- debrid/high-way-free $.identity_cost.detail: Forum requirement is stated; the few-hours review and the quote about hundred forum spammers are not in this capture.
- debrid/scnlog $.limits_note: robots.txt matches the disallow/allow/bot list, but "the forum is a separate login" is not in it.
- debrid/high-way-unlimited $.chaining: Unmetered usenet is stated; "a terabyte without touching the package" and "no other debrid service offers it at any price" are not shown.
- debrid/releasebb $.free_tier.stated: Title and router.parklogic.com are in the capture; no span says the script posts browser fingerprints, and 5,591 bytes is not stated.
- debrid/simply-premium $.limits[1].value: ddownload.com cap is 50 GB, not 250 GB; the 2 GB hitfile.net minimum is right.
- debrid/simply-premium $.interface_detail: Page says so, but "no documented API and no protocol endpoint on the site" is an absence not shown by this page.
- debrid/rlsbb $.limits[0].value: The Crawl-delay line follows the Googlebot/Bingbot group, not the wildcard group, so it is not the wildcard agent delay; 0.1 req/s is derived.
